gameDescriptionHtml:
Mini Cozy Room : Lo-Fi is a relaxing productivity game that combines soothing Lo-Fi music with cozy room decoration.

Cute avatars and pets will accompany you, making your work more enjoyable.

Convenient desktop tools like Pomodoro timers, notes, and to-do lists will boost your productivity.

Game Features

  • Your Own Cozy Workspace – Create the workspace you’ve always dreamed of! Choose from various rooms, furniture, and decorative items. Your beautifully designed workspace will enhance concentration and productivity.
  • Soothing Lo-Fi Music & Ambience – Fill your workspace with diverse Lo-Fi music genres and calming ambient sounds. You’ll soon find yourself relaxed and deeply immersed in your tasks.
  • Innovative Desktop UI and Mini Mode – Freely reposition and resize notes and to-do lists on your desktop. Feeling overwhelmed by the large game screen? Switch to Mini Mode and conveniently place it in your taskbar!
  • Cute Avatars and Pets – Express your unique style with diverse fashion options, hairstyles, and accessories. Move adorable avatars to chairs, beds, or beanbags and assign tasks. Lovely pets like cats, dogs, and hedgehogs will keep you company.
  • Key Features – Gain experience points by listening to music. Higher levels deliver gift parcels to your workspace. Level up to unlock new items and content! Enjoy beautiful music and ambient sounds without the burden of streaming data.

Included DLCs:

  • Ambient Pack
  • Piano Pack
  • Lo-Fi Hip Hop Pack
  • Jazz Pack
  • Classic Pack
